_comment: NSID authority: atproto.music (owned, per Torsten — 2026-09-01). One record per note-on event, published by whichever device/app played it — hardware synth (ESP8266/ESP32 WiFi-native, or Arduino UNO via an OpenWrt tty<>net bridge) or the on-screen-keyboard web app, all through noizetoyz/relay/synth_relay.py. Modeled on station-2's science.iosp.sensor.reading.json — same no-floats rule (AT Protocol's on-wire record model has no floating-point type; every fx amount here is an integer 0-100, not a fraction). Extended 2026-09-02 with mode/sampleId/scrubPos/foldGain/foldBias for two more Mozzi sound-generation techniques (sample scrubbing, wavefolding) alongside the original plain-tone+fx mode, then again same day with mode='filter'/'fm'/'pluck' (a real Mozzi ResonantFilter, phase-modulation FM, and an Ead envelope, per the full Mozzi survey in tracker-vss7) — additive and backward compatible throughout, every new property optional, absent mode means tone (the original and only behavior before any of this). mode='fm' reinterprets foldGain/foldBias as fmIndex/fmRatio rather than adding two more fields — same physical 0-127 slots, different meaning per mode, exactly like every other per-mode field here.

main.description: A single note-on event from a Mozzi-based synth or the web on-screen keyboard, shared live across the network.

deviceId.description: Free-form identifier for the physical device or app instance that played this, e.g. 'esp32-a', 'uno-bridge-1', 'webkeys-torsten'.

synthType.description: Which synth patch/hardware variant produced this, e.g. 'mozzi-esp32-fm', 'mozzi-uno-am', 'webaudio-keys'.

fxType.description: Optional Mozzi effect active on this note, e.g. 'tremolo', 'reverb', 'delay', 'none'.

fxAmount.description: Effect intensity as a percentage (no floats on the wire — see _comment).

cutoffHz.description: Optional filter cutoff frequency in Hz, if the patch exposes a filter control.

mode.description: Which Mozzi sound-generation technique renders this event. Absent means 'tone' (a plain Oscil note, the original and only behavior before 2026-09-02).

sampleId.description: Which compiled-in Mozzi sample table to scrub through, for mode='scrub' (e.g. 'bamboo00', 'bamboo01', 'raven'). Ignored in other modes.

scrubPos.description: Target scrub offset within the selected sample, for mode='scrub' — same 0-127 range convention as note/velocity, mapped onto the sample's actual cell count by the receiving instrument.

foldGain.description: Wavefolder input drive, for mode='fold' — higher folds more. For mode='fm', reinterpreted as fmIndex (modulation depth). Ignored in other modes.

foldBias.description: Wavefolder DC bias, for mode='fold', centered at 64 — shifts where folding happens. For mode='fm', reinterpreted as fmRatio (modulator:carrier frequency ratio, 0-127 mapped to a musically useful range by the receiving instrument). Ignored in other modes.

resonance.description: Resonant filter Q, for mode='filter' (paired with the existing cutoffHz field, which no other mode used before this). Ignored in other modes.

createdAt.description: ATProto-compatible UTC timestamp — use atproto_helpers.get_atproto_utc_time() (relay/), not nebra's — see that module's docstring.
